newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-NEW WORLD RAISED TO "BUY".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-NEW WORLD RAISED TO "BUY".

text.p: New World Infrastructure Ltd was raised to "buy" from "market performer" by JP Morgan, the investment bank said on Thursday.
JP Morgan set a 12-month price target of HK$29.15 and forecast fully diluted 1997 earnings per share at HK$0.76, up 26 percent.
It forecast 1998 EPS at HK$1.15, up 51 percent.

The upgrade was based on New World's commitment to Chinese infrastructure business development, sold EPS growth the next two years, and the increased chance of new project acquisition activities in the next six to 12 months, JP Morgan said.
